intentions: Define a Book model with required fields: id, title, isbn (unique), published_year, available_copies (default 1), and a foreign key author_id.
Define an Author model with required fields: id, name, birth_year, and optional biography.
Define a Member model with required fields: id, name, email (unique), membership_date (default today), and is_active (default True).
Define a Loan model with required fields: id, book_id (foreign key), member_id (foreign key), loan_date, due_date, return_date (nullable), and status (active/returned/overdue).
Implement a BookRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD operations and search/filtering by title, author, ISBN, and available copies.
Implement an AuthorRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD operations and finding books by author.
Implement a MemberRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD operations and filtering active or inactive members.
Implement a LoanRepository with SQLite storage supporting CRUD operations and queries for active, overdue loans, and member/book loan history.
Create a LibraryService layer with business logic including borrow_book, return_book, get_overdue_loans, renew_membership, and search_books with proper validation and transactional integrity.
Build a CLI interface using Click with commands for managing books, authors, members, and loans, including validation and optional flags.
Enforce referential integrity in the database schema using foreign key constraints with CASCADE on delete for books and loans.
Ensure all IDs are auto-incremented primary keys and are optional (int | None) in domain models.
Validate input constraints: ISBN uniqueness, email uniqueness, non-negative available copies, valid author ID references.
Support case-insensitive substring search across title, author name, and ISBN in book search.
Handle transactional borrowing and returning with full rollback on failure.
Enforce that a loan is overdue only when due_date < today and return_date is null.
Raise an error when attempting to return an already returned loan.
Ensure that borrowing reduces available copies to zero when the final copy is borrowed.
Ensure that returning increases available copies by one and updates status to 'returned'.
Allow filtering in CLI commands (e.g., --author, --available-only, --active-only) with appropriate logic in repositories and service layer.
Use type hints throughout the codebase for clarity and maintainability.
Separate concerns using clean architecture: domain models, repositories, service layer, and CLI interface.
